newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom sees 97 gas output 580 bcm.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom sees 97 gas output 580 bcm.

text.p: Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom on Tuesday forecast its 1997 gas output would be 580 billion cubic metres (bcm) compared with 564 bcm in 1996.

Gazprom said in a statement 1996 output was 4.5 bcm higher than in 1995. It said it exported 112.4 bcm to destinations outside the Commonwealth of Independent States in the first 11 months of 1996, against a target for the year of 123.6 bcm. Gazprom said earlier this month it exported 117.4 bcm in 1995.
Gazprom also forecast it would produce nine million tonnes of oil and gas condensate in 1997, compared with 8.6 million tonnes in 1996, which was unchanged on 1995.
Gazprom produces 94 percent of Russia's natural gas.
